findings.issue: cross-language call plans used a VALUE prototype only
findings.resolution: exact VALUE and reference prototypes, Fortran-to-C and C-to-Fortran

findings.issue: no C-descriptor coverage for assumed-shape/assumed-rank dummies
findings.resolution: C side checks rank, CFI_type_float, attribute, elem_len, extents, lower_bound 0 (18.5.3 p3) and column-major values via CFI_address

findings.issue: binding-label plans omitted NAME='' and blank trimming
findings.resolution: NAME='' gives no binding label; NAME='  cf_x  ' gives cf_x

findings.issue: descriptor 'not modified' plans checked only Fortran values
findings.resolution: OVERRULED by the coordinator: 18.6 'the C descriptor shall not be modified' binds the C program, and a snapshot of non-modifying C code is vacuous; recorded as a program obligation with no oracle
